content: This bird will see those pinenuts.

[{"sentence": "Kaigai-uu 'i-düba-naha-neikka 'i-su'a-ggü-tei-ku.", "translation": "That magpie ate up my pinenuts (inspite of me)."}, {"sentence": "Kaiggai-uu 'i-düba-naha-neikka 'i-su'a-gü-tei-ku.", "translation": "The magpie ate up my pinenuts inspite of me."}, {"sentence": "Mahu tüba-nokka 'u-düka-dü 'oonno'oho-düa tu'ihiima tü-dü-gütübuhei-nna.", "translation": "He eats the pine nuts and anything he comes across (speaking of specific bird)."}, {"sentence": "Tüa-daagwa hiinno'o-mana tüba-ka-tei-gaa-wei-düa.", "translation": "We will go and collect pinenuts again sometime."}, {"sentence": "Mahu puhibanagi-dü-eikka tsiidoopi'-eikka 'a-buni-ti.", "translation": "She sees the green bird."}]

[{"lexical_unit": "paa", "senses": [{"gloss": "pinenut mush", "definition": "To make pinenut mush.", "examples": [{"form": "'Oonno'oho nüü-düa, 'ui-baa-gü-pü nüü tüba'-aa.", "translation": "And I had also made them pine nut mush."}, {"form": "'Uhu-bünno' paa-weidü.", "translation": "She intends on making pine nut mush."}, {"form": "Hiibü-uu 'unnihi 'u-na-ŵani-gwee-su-düa 'i-bia-uu 'awa-kida'a-ggu paa-tei-ti tüba-na.", "translation": "What... at those kinds of gatherings my mother would make so much pine nut mush."}, {"form": "Pinnahei 'uhu müna'wi-kida' na-ŵaappa'i-ti 'u-na-baa-si-ukka.", "translation": "Because it takes a long time to be made, if pine nut mush is made."}, {"form": "Nüü paa-si 'oonno'oho nüügwa ukkahuna tüka-ti.", "translation": "I made pine nut mush and then we ate that."}, {"form": "Nüümü-ii tüba'-aa 'u-na-baa-nna sutsamaa'i-ti.", "translation": "The Indian People like pine nut soup."}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "'ehu", "senses": [{"gloss": "pinenut stick", "definition": "Pinenut stick with a hook used for shaking limbs of the pinion trees in order to bring down pine nuts.", "examples": [{"form": "Toya-ŵa nüügwa mia-si-ukka nii-'ehu-na noo-pü tu'ihiibü-na nii-düba-ka-wei-nna 'u-ŵama.", "translation": "When we go to the mountains we'll take our pine nut stick, and whatever we'll use to gather pine nuts with."}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "tüba", "senses": [{"gloss": "pine nut", "definition": "Pine nuts from the pinion pine tree. Food source for Great Basin tribes.", "examples": [{"form": "Tüba-ii-düa nuhi-zhaŵu kama-ti.", "translation": "And the pine nuts taste really good!"}, {"form": "Nüü 'a-buni-ti 'a-düba-ka-nna.", "translation": "I saw her collecting pine nuts."}, {"form": "'Oonno'oho 'üü tüba-ŵahi-ku-si-ukka 'üü 'ü-dü-dügü-nna 'u-ŵaddü-aa tüka-boo-ti.", "translation": "And then, once you've gone out to get pine nuts, you can go about eating from those you've placed."}, {"form": "Tüba-mahi-shi-ukka nüügwa tü-noo-ku-si-ukka 'oonno'oho nüügwa pitü-si-ukka tü-hani-ti 'ikibi-du-ti.", "translation": "Once we scouted for pine nuts, we'd haul them, and then we'd arrive to prepare and make mush."}, {"form": "Lida-uu-düa tüba-tua-ki'ei-dü 'u-nübaa-su-ukka.", "translation": "And Lida always produces pine nuts, when it snows."}, {"form": "Tüba'-aa 'i-ŵakka.", "translation": "Give me some pine nuts to eat."}, {"form": "'Uhu-wa' a-na-düba'a-ga-nna?", "translation": "Was it during the pine nut harvesting time?"}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "tübapü", "senses": [{"gloss": "pinion pine", "definition": "Pinion pine tree.", "examples": [{"form": "Tübabü-ii na-wüddabi-gü-pü 'u-mia-pü-dugu-ddü-uu.", "translation": "The pinions were knocked down where it went through there (wind)."}, {"form": "Wünüpü-nokka nüü 'u-duha katü-ti.", "translation": "I camped under the pinion trees."}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "tübamahi", "senses": [{"gloss": "scout pine nuts", "definition": "To scout for pine nuts.", "examples": [{"form": "'Oonno'oho 'üü tüba-ŵahi-ku-si-ukka 'üü 'ü-dü-dügü-nna 'u-ŵa-ddü-aa tüka-boo-ti.", "translation": "And then, once you scouted for pine nuts, you can take what you place (aside) and eat off that."}, {"form": "Tüba-mahi-shi-ukka nüügwa tü-noo-ku-si-ukka 'oonno'oho nüügwa pitü-si-ukka tü-hani-ti 'ikibi-du-ti.", "translation": "Scouting for pine nuts, we bring some (back) and then upon arrival we prepare it, making mush."}]}]}]

[{"lexical_unit": "puni", "senses": [{"gloss": "see", "definition": "To see.", "examples": [{"form": "Tsaŵu-iddu i-buni-ku-nna-ii.", "translation": "It's good to see you."}, {"form": "Tsaŵu naama-ti nüü 'ü-buni-si-ukka ('ü-buni-ku-si-ukka).", "translation": "I was happy to see you."}, {"form": "'Ü-buni-kwaa-ti nüü 'u-binna-tugu-su-ukka.", "translation": "I'll see you the next time."}, {"form": "Nüü 'ionnoho wünü-si-ukka kadu' ui-buni-ti.", "translation": "When I stood here, I couldn't see them."}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "pitaŵa", "senses": [{"gloss": "look", "definition": "To look at something.", "examples": [{"form": "Naatsi'-ii-bünno' 'a-dübinuhi-wei-gwee-ikka 'iga-tei-ku-si tei-bitaŵa-ti.", "translation": "The boy entered the playhouse then look at us."}, {"form": "Kadu' üügwa tsaŵu tü-bitaŵa-ti.", "translation": "You guys aren't looking around good (enough)."}, {"form": "Tü-baagwa-na na-bitaŵa-gü-gaa-dü.", "translation": "He's going to get his blood looked at (check up on at the doctors)."}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "tsapuni", "senses": [{"gloss": "look", "definition": "To take a look while using the hand(s) to move something aside to get a better look.", "examples": []}]}, {"lexical_unit": "puttabühi", "senses": [{"gloss": "see well", "definition": "To be able to see something well, to clearly see something.", "examples": [{"form": "'Oonno'oho nüü ka' tü-buttabühi-ni-ukka 'u-ŵan-dugu mia-ddabi-tei-ti 'oonno'oho na-mutsuku'i-bitü-ga'.", "translation": "And then, while I couldn't see clearly, I went right into it, and then bumped my head."}, {"form": "Hanni'i-tugu mahu tü-bittabühi-wei annikku?", "translation": "How is he going to see it now?"}]}]}, {"lexical_unit": "manakkagü", "senses": [{"gloss": "show (example)", "definition": "To show how by example, to show someone how to do something.", "examples": [{"form": "'I-ŵanakka-gü 'i-dü-dagwüna'i-wei-nokka.", "translation": "Show me how to throw (the ball)."}]}]}]
